description: This PHP script is a client for interacting with a TestLink API, specifically testing the getBuildsForTestPlan and getLatestBuildForTestPlan methods. It includes setup for API calls, debugging, and outputs for testing test plans using the IXR_Client.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A class used for making XML-RPC calls to the server, instantiated with the server URL and used to send method calls.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Executes a test call to the specified API method using the provided IXR_Client instance and arguments.
